# vgi-bea

Discover BEA datasets, parameters and parameter values, then retrieve national, regional, industry and international economic accounts. Use a bea_api secret with api_key or BEA_API_KEY. BEA has no pagination: narrow parameters_json to fit a bounded response; max_rows explicitly caps returned rows. Numeric values retain published units; unit_multiplier is the base-10 exponent and is not applied automatically. Suppressed values become NULL, with original value_text and notes preserved. NULL arguments are rejected. Missing optional response fields return NULL. Upstream errors fail the query; SQL WHERE filters are local.

Queries use bounded HTTP responses and retries. Credentials stay out of continuation state. See README.md for deployment and operational limits.
